dataset.name: quickbite-support-golden
dataset.description: Hand-written support questions with reference answers and gold policy chunks, including 12 deliberately out-of-scope questions.

metrics.label: Faithfulness
metrics.description: Share of claims in the answer that are supported by the retrieved context.

metrics.label: Answer relevancy
metrics.description: How directly the answer addresses the question that was asked.

metrics.label: Context precision
metrics.description: Share of retrieved chunks that were actually relevant, weighted by rank.

metrics.label: Context recall
metrics.description: Share of the reference answer's facts that appear in the retrieved context.

headline.summary: Cutting top-k from 5 to 3 raised context precision from 0.54 to 0.64.
headline.tradeoff: Recall dipped slightly: a few multi-policy questions lost their fourth-ranked chunk.
